## Purpose

This analysis compares incoming CellChat signaling to GBCs at p5 and p22. It:

1. extracts every inferred ligand-receptor interaction received by GBCs;
2. summarizes interaction counts and summed CellChat probabilities by sender;
3. calculates the p5-minus-p22 change in pathway strength for each sender;
4. produces the focused six-sender figure and the all-sender companion figure;
5. exports the plotted tables and PNG and PDF files.


```{r setup, include=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
# Load only the packages and shared helpers needed for the CellChat summaries and plots.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  cache = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  dpi = 150
)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(CellChat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
})

data_dir <- normalizePath(params$data_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)

early_age <- params$early_age
late_age <- params$late_age
comparison_ages <- c(early_age, late_age)
receiver <- params$receiver

sender_palette <- c(
  "mOSN" = "#a65628",
  "iOSN" = "#bc9dcc",
  "Sustentacular" = "#b2df8a",
  "Fibroblasts" = "#984ea3",
  "GBC" = "#f29403",
  "INP" = "#66c2a5",
  "HBC" = "#377eb8",
  "Respiratory_Basal" = "#4daf4a",
  "Inflammatory_Monocyte_like" = "#d62728",
  "Microvillus" = "#1b9e77",
  "Respiratory_Goblet" = "#f781bf",
  "OEC" = "#17becf",
  "Macrophage_like" = "#8c564b"
)

age_palette <- c(
  "p5" = "#2c7fb8",
  "p22" = "#9ecae1"
)

# Functions used to load, summarize, and plot the CellChat object.
format_sender_label <- function(x) {
  gsub("_", " ", x, fixed = TRUE)
}

load_cellchat_list <- function(path) {
  env <- new.env(parent = baseenv())
  loaded_names <- load(path, envir = env)
  preferred_names <- c("object.list", "obj.list")
  object_name <- preferred_names[preferred_names %in% loaded_names][1]
  if (is.na(object_name)) {
    stop("The RData file does not contain `object.list` or `obj.list`. Found: ",
         paste(loaded_names, collapse = ", "))
  }
  object_list <- get(object_name, envir = env, inherits = FALSE)
  if (!is.list(object_list)) stop("Loaded object `", object_name, "` is not a list.")
  object_list
}

get_incoming_lr <- function(cellchat, dataset_name, receiver_name) {
  CellChat::subsetCommunication(cellchat, slot.name = "net") %>%
    filter(target == receiver_name) %>%
    transmute(
      dataset = dataset_name,
      sender = as.character(source),
      receiver = as.character(target),
      pathway_name = as.character(pathway_name),
      ligand = as.character(ligand),
      receptor = as.character(receptor),
      prob = as.numeric(prob)
    )
}

get_incoming_pathways <- function(cellchat, dataset_name, receiver_name) {
  CellChat::subsetCommunication(cellchat, slot.name = "netP") %>%
    filter(target == receiver_name) %>%
    transmute(
      dataset = dataset_name,
      sender = as.character(source),
      receiver = as.character(target),
      pathway_name = as.character(pathway_name),
      prob = as.numeric(prob)
    )
}

make_sender_pathway_panel <- function(sender_name, add_panel_tag = FALSE) {
  panel_data <- focused_pathways %>%
    filter(sender == sender_name) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs_delta), pathway_name) %>%
    slice_head(n = params$top_n_pathways) %>%
    mutate(pathway_name = factor(pathway_name, levels = rev(pathway_name)))
  sender_color <- sender_palette[[sender_name]]
  if (is.null(sender_color) || is.na(sender_color)) sender_color <- "#555555"
  ggplot(panel_data, aes(x = delta_p5_minus_p22, y = pathway_name)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_point(aes(size = abs_delta), color = sender_color, alpha = 0.95) +
    scale_size(range = c(1.5, 4.3), guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(-pathway_x_limit, pathway_x_limit),
      breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 3),
      labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.001)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = format_sender_label(sender_name), x = NULL, y = NULL,
      tag = if (add_panel_tag) "B" else NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 9.5, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      plot.tag.position = c(0.01, 1.10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7.2),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(4, 7, 4, 7)
    )
}

```

## Input object

Place `cellchat_input.RData` in the repository's `data/` folder. All
generated tables and figures are written back to that same folder.

```{r locate-input}
# Locate the CellChat input object.
cellchat_object_path <- normalizePath(
  file.path(data_dir, "cellchat_input.RData"),
  winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE
)

cat("CellChat input: cellchat_input.RData\n")
cat("Output directory:", data_dir, "\n")
```

```{r load-object, eval=!isTRUE(params$use_exported_tables)}
# Load the per-age CellChat object list and retain p5 and p22.
object_list <- load_cellchat_list(cellchat_object_path)
object_list <- object_list[comparison_ages]
cat("Analyzing:", paste(names(object_list), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## Extract incoming GBC communication

`n_links` is the number of significant ligand-receptor rows returned by
`CellChat::subsetCommunication(..., slot.name = "net")`. `total_weight` is
the sum of their CellChat probabilities. Pathway probabilities come from the
`netP` slot and are summed within sender, age, and pathway.

```{r extract-communication, eval=!isTRUE(params$use_exported_tables)}
# Extract ligand-receptor and pathway communication received by GBCs at each age.
incoming_lr <- bind_rows(lapply(names(object_list), function(age) {
  get_incoming_lr(object_list[[age]], age, receiver)
}))

incoming_pathways <- bind_rows(lapply(names(object_list), function(age) {
  get_incoming_pathways(object_list[[age]], age, receiver)
}))
```

```{r summarize-communication}
# Summarize incoming interaction counts, total probabilities, and pathway changes by sender.
if (isTRUE(params$use_exported_tables)) {
  cache_files <- c(
    incoming = file.path(data_dir, "cellchat_incoming.csv"),
    sender = file.path(data_dir, "cellchat_senders.csv"),
    pathway = file.path(data_dir, "cellchat_pathways.csv")
  )
  incoming_by_sender <- read.csv(cache_files[["incoming"]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  sender_summary_wide <- read.csv(cache_files[["sender"]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  pathway_delta <- read.csv(cache_files[["pathway"]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
} else {
  all_senders <- sort(unique(incoming_lr$sender))

  incoming_by_sender <- incoming_lr %>%
    group_by(dataset, sender) %>%
    summarise(
      total_weight = sum(prob, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_links = dplyr::n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    complete(
      dataset = comparison_ages,
      sender = all_senders,
      fill = list(total_weight = 0, n_links = 0)
    )

  pathway_delta <- incoming_pathways %>%
    group_by(dataset, sender, pathway_name) %>%
    summarise(total_prob = sum(prob, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = dataset,
      values_from = total_prob,
      values_fill = 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      prob_early = .data[[early_age]],
      prob_late = .data[[late_age]],
      delta_p5_minus_p22 = prob_early - prob_late,
      abs_delta = abs(delta_p5_minus_p22)
    )

  sender_summary_wide <- incoming_by_sender %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = dataset,
      values_from = c(total_weight, n_links),
      values_fill = 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      early_weight = .data[[paste0("total_weight_", early_age)]],
      late_weight = .data[[paste0("total_weight_", late_age)]],
      early_links = .data[[paste0("n_links_", early_age)]],
      late_links = .data[[paste0("n_links_", late_age)]],
      delta_weight_p5_minus_p22 = early_weight - late_weight,
      percent_drop_p5_to_p22 = if_else(
        early_weight > 0,
        100 * delta_weight_p5_minus_p22 / early_weight,
        NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(early_weight), desc(early_links), sender)
}

sender_order <- sender_summary_wide$sender
selected_senders <- head(sender_order, params$top_n_senders)

stopifnot(length(selected_senders) == params$top_n_senders)

cat("Focused sender order:", paste(format_sender_label(selected_senders), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r export-tables, cache=FALSE}
# Save the three plotted data tables.
if (isTRUE(params$save_outputs)) {
  write.csv(
    incoming_by_sender,
    file.path(data_dir, "cellchat_incoming.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  write.csv(
    sender_summary_wide,
    file.path(data_dir, "cellchat_senders.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  write.csv(
    pathway_delta,
    file.path(data_dir, "cellchat_pathways.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

## Focused six-sender figure

Senders are ranked by p5 summed interaction strength, matching the current
figure. Positive pathway deltas are stronger at p5; negative values are
stronger at p22.

```{r build-focused-figure}
# Build the focused count, strength, and pathway panels.
focused_age_levels <- c(late_age, early_age)

incoming_focused <- incoming_by_sender %>%
  filter(sender %in% selected_senders) %>%
  mutate(
    dataset = factor(dataset, levels = focused_age_levels),
    sender = factor(sender, levels = selected_senders),
    sender_display = factor(
      format_sender_label(as.character(sender)),
      levels = format_sender_label(selected_senders)
    )
  )

focused_age_palette <- age_palette[focused_age_levels]

focused_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, lineheight = 0.95),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.5, angle = 50, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8.5),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(0.16, "in"),
    plot.margin = margin(4, 5, 3, 4)
  )

count_plot <- ggplot(
  incoming_focused,
  aes(x = sender_display, y = n_links, fill = dataset)
) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.72), width = 0.62) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = focused_age_palette, name = "Age") +
  labs(
    title = "Inferred incoming\ninteractions to GBCs",
    x = "Sender",
    y = "Number interactions",
    tag = "A"
  ) +
  focused_theme +
  theme(
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.01, 0.99)
  )

weight_plot <- ggplot(
  incoming_focused,
  aes(x = sender_display, y = total_weight, fill = dataset)
) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.72), width = 0.62) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = focused_age_palette, name = "Age") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.001)) +
  labs(
    title = "Inferred interaction\nstrength to GBCs",
    x = "Sender",
    y = "Summed probability"
  ) +
  focused_theme

focused_pathways <- pathway_delta %>%
  filter(sender %in% selected_senders)

pathway_x_limit <- max(abs(focused_pathways$delta_p5_minus_p22), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.08
if (!is.finite(pathway_x_limit) || pathway_x_limit == 0) pathway_x_limit <- 1


pathway_panels <- lapply(seq_along(selected_senders), function(i) {
  make_sender_pathway_panel(selected_senders[[i]], add_panel_tag = i == 1)
})

focused_top_row <- (count_plot | weight_plot) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "top")

focused_bottom_grid <- wrap_plots(pathway_panels, ncol = 3)

focused_figure <- focused_top_row / focused_bottom_grid +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.92, 1.12))
```

```{r show-focused-figure, echo=FALSE, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=7.8, out.width='85%'}
# Print the focused six-sender figure inline.
focused_figure
```

```{r save-focused-figure, cache=FALSE}
# Save the focused figure.
focused_png <- file.path(data_dir, "cellchat_top6.png")
focused_pdf <- file.path(data_dir, "cellchat_top6.pdf")

if (isTRUE(params$save_outputs)) {
  ggsave(focused_png, focused_figure, width = 6.5, height = 7.8, units = "in", dpi = 300)
  ggsave(focused_pdf, focused_figure, width = 6.5, height = 7.8, units = "in")
}
```

## All analyzed sender classes

This companion panel retains every sender present in both comparison inputs.
The sender order is the same p5-strength ranking used to choose the focused
six-sender subset.

```{r build-all-sender-figure}
# Build the companion count and strength panels for every analyzed sender class.
all_sender_data <- incoming_by_sender %>%
  mutate(
    dataset = factor(dataset, levels = c(early_age, late_age)),
    sender = factor(sender, levels = rev(sender_order)),
    sender_display = factor(
      format_sender_label(as.character(sender)),
      levels = rev(format_sender_label(sender_order))
    )
  )

all_age_palette <- age_palette[c(early_age, late_age)]

all_count_plot <- ggplot(
  all_sender_data,
  aes(x = n_links, y = sender_display, fill = dataset)
) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.72), width = 0.62) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = all_age_palette, name = "Age") +
  labs(
    title = "Incoming inferred interactions to GBC",
    x = "Number of inferred interactions",
    y = "Analyzed sender class"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

all_weight_plot <- ggplot(
  all_sender_data,
  aes(x = total_weight, y = sender_display, fill = dataset)
) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.72), width = 0.62) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = all_age_palette, name = "Age") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.001)) +
  labs(
    title = "Incoming interaction strength to GBC",
    x = "Summed CellChat probability",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

all_sender_figure <- (all_count_plot | all_weight_plot) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r show-all-sender-figure, echo=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=5.8, out.width='100%'}
# Print the all-sender companion figure inline.
all_sender_figure
```

```{r save-all-sender-figure, cache=FALSE}
# Save the all-sender figure.
all_sender_png <- file.path(data_dir, "cellchat_all.png")
all_sender_pdf <- file.path(data_dir, "cellchat_all.pdf")

if (isTRUE(params$save_outputs)) {
  ggsave(all_sender_png, all_sender_figure, width = 10, height = 5.8, units = "in", dpi = 300)
  ggsave(all_sender_pdf, all_sender_figure, width = 10, height = 5.8, units = "in")
}
```

## Values used in the figures

```{r figure-values, echo=FALSE}
# Display the sender-level values used in the figures.
display_table <- sender_summary_wide %>%
  transmute(
    sender = format_sender_label(sender),
    p5_links = early_links,
    p22_links = late_links,
    p5_probability = early_weight,
    p22_probability = late_weight,
    p5_minus_p22_probability = delta_weight_p5_minus_p22,
    percent_drop_p5_to_p22
  )

knitr::kable(display_table, digits = 5)
```

## Output manifest

```{r output-manifest, echo=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
# List the generated tables and figures.
manifest <- data.frame(
  file = c(
    basename(focused_png),
    basename(focused_pdf),
    basename(all_sender_png),
    basename(all_sender_pdf),
    "cellchat_incoming.csv",
    "cellchat_senders.csv",
    "cellchat_pathways.csv"
  ),
  description = c(
    "Focused six-sender figure (PNG)",
    "Focused six-sender figure (PDF)",
    "All-sender figure (PNG)",
    "All-sender figure (PDF)",
    "Long sender-by-age summary",
    "Wide p5/p22 sender summary",
    "Sender-by-pathway p5-minus-p22 changes"
  )
)

if (isTRUE(params$save_outputs)) {
  write.csv(manifest, file.path(data_dir, "cellchat_manifest.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}
knitr::kable(manifest)
```
